description: Marine and Harbour Areas (LGATE-235) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. Republished with a redefined set of attributes, Marine and Harbour Areas are proclaimed areas of both land and water under the Marine and Harbours Act 1981 is vested in The Minister for Transport, and administered by the Department of Transport. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are admin, csadmin, slip, subscription. It offers 13 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, data dictionary, data services, fgdb. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
